# Labeling rubric — ingestion-time supersession

**Status: v1, frozen 2026-09-29.** Do not edit this file after labeling starts. If a case
shows that a rule is wrong, record it in the `notes` column, finish the batch, and only then
bump the version and re-label the cases the change affects. Every change goes in the log at
the bottom.

## The task

Each case is one **incoming** document `d*` and the **knowledge base** (KB), which holds
every document dated *before* `d*`. You decide what the ingestion pipeline should do with
`d*`:

| Label | Meaning | Pipeline action |
|---|---|---|
| `UPDATE` | `d*` replaces information in an existing KB document, so a student reading the old one would act on outdated facts | index `d*`, retire the target |
| `NEW` | `d*` is about something the KB does not cover yet | index `d*` |
| `REDUNDANT` | `d*` adds no actionable information beyond one existing KB document | skip `d*` (or link it) |

For `UPDATE` you also give `gold_target`: the KB document that `d*` replaces. For
`REDUNDANT`, give the document it duplicates in the same column. For `NEW`, leave it empty.

## Decision procedure (apply in order)

1. **Same program, event or rule?** Look for a KB document about the *same* program, event
   or regulation: the same partner school and program, the same scholarship, the same
   selection round type. A shared template or shared office boilerplate does **not** make two
   documents the same program. If there is no such document → **NEW**.
2. **Anything actionable changed?** Compare `d*` with the *most recent* matching document.
   Actionable means a student would need to do something different: a deadline, date,
   cycle/semester, fee, quota, eligibility rule, required document, procedure, link or
   contact.
   - Something changed → **UPDATE**, target = that most recent matching document.
   - Nothing changed → **REDUNDANT**, target = that document.

## Edge cases (these override the procedure above)

| Situation | Label | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Same recurring program, new cycle (2025 → 2026 edition), even when the wording is identical apart from the year | `UPDATE` | the validity period changed, so students of the new cycle must act on the new document |
| Pure re-post: same cycle, same content, maybe a typo fix or new formatting | `REDUNDANT` | |
| Deadline extension or correction notice for an existing post (「延長」「更正」) | `UPDATE` | even though it only changes one field |
| English and Chinese versions of the *same* announcement, same cycle | `REDUNDANT` | a translation, not a replacement |
| Two different scholarships or schools that share a template | `NEW` | the false-UPDATE trap |
| Heavily reworded or restructured successor of the same program | `UPDATE` | the missed-UPDATE trap |
| Results or admission lists (「錄取名單」「放榜」) for an earlier call | `NEW` | the call is still valid for its own facts; results are new information |
| An info session (「說明會」) about a program that has its own KB post | `NEW` | a separate event with its own date |
| Next edition of a **recurring** info session, interview schedule or school-selection session (2024 session → 2025 session) | `UPDATE` | same recurring event, new cycle |
| Second selection round / next stage (「第二次甄選」「第三階段」) of the same call | `UPDATE` | a new application window replaces the old deadline |
| Numbered lecture in a series (「系列之二十八」) | `NEW` | each lecture is a different event |
| Post with an empty body but the same title and cycle as an older post | `REDUNDANT` + `unsure` | nothing new is visible |
| Several KB documents all match (e.g. 2023, 2024, 2025 editions) | `UPDATE` | target is the **most recent** one; the older ones were already superseded |
| Matching predecessor exists in both zh and en | `UPDATE` | list both as `oir-10|oir-11`; either counts as correct |
| Predecessor is more than 3 years old | label normally | note `old_predecessor` |
| You cannot tell without opening an attachment the case does not include | best guess | put `unsure` in notes; these cases are excluded from the κ subset |

## Columns

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| `case_id` | fixed, do not edit |
| `gold_label` | `UPDATE` / `NEW` / `REDUNDANT` |
| `gold_target` | doc_id(s), `|`-separated if more than one is acceptable |
| `changed_field` | for UPDATE: `cycle`, `deadline`, `fee`, `eligibility`, `procedure`, `link`, `other` |
| `notes` | **one sentence saying why**, in English (e.g. "2026 edition of the same Kansai summer program; deadline moved"). Plus flags via checkboxes: `unsure`, `old_predecessor`, `template_trap`, `reworded`, `translation`. The reason is not optional: dev-split reasons become the few-shot exemplars for M3, and a case without one cannot be used |
| `annotator` | your initials |
| `seconds` | time spent, filled automatically by the labeling tool |

## Double annotation

- A second annotator (a classmate, **not** anyone involved in building the system) labels a
  random **40-case** subset blind, using only this file and the labeling tool.
- Report Cohen's κ on `gold_label`. **κ ≥ 0.6 = proceed. κ < 0.6 = the rubric is
  under-specified:** revise it, bump the version, re-label.
- Resolve disagreements by discussion; the adjudicated label becomes gold. Keep both raw
  labels for the report.
